experiment: E6: hoist/inline the w fp32 path

results.name: w32_cw4
results.note: precompute w in an fp32 shared buffer once; ~2x SLOWER - extra fp32 UB pressure

results.name: inline_cw4
results.note: cast w_ub inline, no wf fragment; slightly worse

results.name: w32_cw4_t1024
results.note: more threads does not rescue the fp32-shared variant

conclusion: the per-step wf fragment is the best of the three; hoisting w to an fp32 shared buffer costs ~2x (UB pressure), inline cast is slightly worse.
decision: KEEP wf-fragment (no change from E4 baseline).
